get.description: Paginated list of records for one of the 23 data tabs, filtered by academic year (year-scoped tabs only) and free-text search across all row values. Sort fields are whitelisted server-side (id, createdAt, updatedAt, academicYear, status, workflowStatus); unknown fields silently fall back to the default.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Tab id - one of: buildings, classrooms, laboratories, equipment, library, ict-infrastructure, hostels, sports-facilities, seminar-halls, transport, green-initiatives, energy-management, water-management, waste-management, green-audit, fire-safety, security-infrastructure, emergency-preparedness, insurance-compliance, power-infrastructure, water-supply, internet-network, utility-assets

parameters.name: academicYear
parameters.description: Academic Year filter (year-scoped tabs only), e.g. 2025-26

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across all row values

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description: Sort field (id, createdAt, updatedAt, academicYear, status, workflowStatus)

400.description: Validation failed - unknown tab id (invalid sort fields silently fall back to the default)

post.description: Creates a record for a data tab. The JSON body carries the tab's field set (validated against the tab schema; unknown fields are ignored). The workflow status is stamped by the server as 'draft' - coordinators cannot set workflow statuses. A duplicate unique field (e.g. buildingCode) returns 409.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Tab id - one of: buildings, classrooms, laboratories, equipment, library, ict-infrastructure, hostels, sports-facilities, seminar-halls, transport, green-initiatives, energy-management, water-management, waste-management, green-audit, fire-safety, security-infrastructure, emergency-preparedness, insurance-compliance, power-infrastructure, water-supply, internet-network, utility-assets

requestBody.description: Section record field set for the tab (see the example for buildings; other tabs use their own fields)

409.description: Conflict - duplicate unique field (buildingCode / equipmentCode / vehicleNumber)

400.description: Validation failed - missing/invalid fields, invalid select value, invalid cross-tab reference

post.description: Parses and validates a CSV against the tab schema. Returns per-row errors and a preview WITHOUT persisting any record. The returned uploadId is used by the confirm call. Invalid rows are listed; valid rows are imported only after confirmation.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Tab id - one of: buildings, classrooms, laboratories, equipment, library, ict-infrastructure, hostels, sports-facilities, seminar-halls, transport, green-initiatives, energy-management, water-management, waste-management, green-audit, fire-safety, security-infrastructure, emergency-preparedness, insurance-compliance, power-infrastructure, water-supply, internet-network, utility-assets

parameters.name: academicYear
parameters.description: Academic Year (optional; year-scoped tabs read it from the file when present, otherwise this value is used as the default)

file.description: CSV file (header row must match the section's csvColumn labels)

400.description: Validation failed - missing required headers or malformed CSV (per-row validation errors are returned in the 200 preview instead)

200.description: CSV validated - preview returned (nothing persisted yet)

post.description: Persists the valid rows of a previously validated upload. Invalid rows, duplicates (in-file or in-database) and rows whose cross-tab references no longer exist are skipped. The upload is logged and moved to 'pending'/'submitted'. The staged upload row is locked so concurrent confirms cannot double-import.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Tab id - one of: buildings, classrooms, laboratories, equipment, library, ict-infrastructure, hostels, sports-facilities, seminar-halls, transport, green-initiatives, energy-management, water-management, waste-management, green-audit, fire-safety, security-infrastructure, emergency-preparedness, insurance-compliance, power-infrastructure, water-supply, internet-network, utility-assets

400.description: Bad request - staged upload not found, wrong tab, or already confirmed

200.description: CSV confirmed - counts of imported/skipped rows

post.description: Uploads one or more evidence/supporting documents (max 10 MB each; accepted types: .pdf, .docx, .zip, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .xlsx, .csv). parameters.name: recordId

uploadId.description: Id of the staged upload, used by the confirm call

totalRows.description: Total rows parsed from the file

errors.description: All validation errors across invalid rows

previewRows.description: Per-row preview used by the confirm UI

CsvValidationResponse.description: Phase-1 CSV validation result. Nothing is persisted; the staged uploadId is returned so the frontend can call POST /sections/{tabId}/upload/confirm after the user reviews the preview.

additionalProperties.description: Coerced/normalized field values of the row

data.description: Coerced/normalized field values of the row

errors.description: Errors for this row (empty when valid)

uploadId.description: Id returned by the phase-1 validate call

CsvUploadConfirmRequest.description: Phase 2 of the two-phase CSV upload: confirms the previously validated (staged) upload

skippedCount.description: Records skipped (invalid, duplicate, or stale reference)

CsvUploadConfirmResponse.description: Phase-2 CSV result: how many valid rows were persisted and how many were skipped (invalid rows and duplicates)

additionalProperties.description: Uploaded files keyed by category id (or the tab id / 'documents' when no category was supplied)

files.description: Uploaded files keyed by category id (or the tab id / 'documents' when no category was supplied)

DocumentUploadResponse.description: Result of a multi-file document upload

AttentionItem.description: A tab with records requiring attention

verified.description: Records in the verification pipeline (validated onwards)

dataCompleteness.description: Percentage of required cells filled across the module's records

evidenceCompleteness.description: Percentage of records with at least one linked evidence document

verificationPercent.description: Percentage of records in the verification pipeline

readinessScore.description: Overall readiness = average of the three metrics above

RepositoryMetric.description: Readiness/completeness metrics (0-100) for one repository module

attentionItems.description: Tabs needing attention (pending verification or rejected records), highest pending first

VerificationStatusResponse.description: Verification status: overall stats, per-repository readiness metrics and per-tab attention items

UploadHistoryResponse.description: Upload log with KPI summary cards and a paginated list

restricted.description: Actions reserved for other roles (verification/approval, master data, user management)

items.description: Actions reserved for other roles (verification/approval, master data, user management)

Permissions.description: What the role can and cannot do

ProfileResponse.description: Coordinator profile: identity, assignment scope, readiness and permissions matrix

count.description: Number of documents in this category

CategoryCount.description: Document count for one category badge

categories.description: Per-category document counts (all 7 categories, even when 0)

DocumentListResponse.description: Paginated supporting documents plus per-category counts for the badge UI

scoreCards.description: Four 0-100 score cards (Repository Completion, Evidence Completion, Verification, Infrastructure Readiness)

modules.description: Per-module KPI grids covering all 23 tabs

DashboardResponse.description: Dashboard aggregation: score cards, module KPI grids, analytics highlights, pending counts and recent activities

ModuleKpi.description: KPI grid for one repository module
